channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pacific Rim remains temporarily closed after a fire
item.description: The Sarasota County Fire Department responded to Pacific Rim around 6:50 a.m. on July 18. A woman at a nearby businesses noticed smoke and called 911.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Wisconsin tornado causes extensive damage and cuts power to thousands of homes
item.description: A tornado struck northeastern Wisconsin on Monday, sending workers sheltering in office basements and knocking out power to more than 30,000 people.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Crews in France race against looming heatwave as they battle 'completely unprecedented fire'
item.description: Fire crews in France are racing to contain a historic wildfire, hoping to gain the upper hand on the blaze before temperatures soar later this week.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Brandon home seriously damaged after tree goes through roof
item.description: A Brandon homeowner is working to repair extensive structural damage after a massive tree smashed through her roof during a Friday storm while she was out of town.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Lakewood Ranch residents push back against 200-townhome workforce housing development
item.description: A proposed workforce housing development in Manatee County drew hundreds of concerned residents to a packed public workshop Monday night in Lakewood Ranch.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Pasco County treasure hunters search remote island for $200M fortune
item.description: An expedition team traveled by boat to a remote island off Pasco County to hunt for a legendary $200 million Spanish treasure believed to be buried in the early 1800s.
